# Life Cycle Initiative

> > A UNEP-hosted initiative providing global frameworks and tools for life cycle assessment (LCA) databases and plastic pollution hotspotting to support environmental decision-making.

The Life Cycle Initiative operates the Global LCA Data Access (GLAD) network and develops methodological frameworks like the National Guidance for Plastic Pollution Hotspotting. These resources support countries and organizations in conducting lifecycle assessments and prioritizing environmental interventions through standardized, science-based approaches.

## Key Topics

- Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)
- GLAD network (Global LCA Data Access network)
- Plastic pollution hotspotting
- LCA database development
- UNEP (United Nations Environment Programme)
- IUCN (International Union for Conservation of Nature)
- Database interoperability
- Capacity building
- Intervention prioritization
- Waste management
- Value chain analysis
- Environmental policy frameworks
- Data management
- Lifecycle assessment methodology

## LCA Database & GLAD Network

- [LCA Database Helpdesk](https://helpdesk.lifecycleinitiative.org/): LCA Database Helpdesk homepage for GLAD network data management support
- [Resources](https://helpdesk.lifecycleinitiative.org/resources/): LCA database development resources and GLAD network materials
- [Operationalization](https://helpdesk.lifecycleinitiative.org/operationalization/): LCA database operationalization guide for GLAD network implementation

## Plastic Pollution Hotspotting

- [National Guidance for Plastic Pollution Hotspotting and Shaping Action](https://plastichotspotting.lifecycleinitiative.org/): UNEP/IUCN framework for prioritizing plastic pollution interventions
- [Modules](https://plastichotspotting.lifecycleinitiative.org/modules/): Guidance modules for plastic pollution hotspotting methodology
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://plastichotspotting.lifecycleinitiative.org/faq/): FAQ for National Guidance plastic pollution hotspotting methodology
